:::{#def-fisher-scoring}
#### Fisher scoring

**Fisher scoring** (also called the method of scoring)
is the [Newton-Raphson algorithm](#def-newton-raphson)
with the observed information $\oinf(\vx; \esttmp{\th})$ in the update
replaced by the [expected information](#def-einf) $\einf(\esttmp{\th})$:

$$
\esttmp{\th} \leftarrow \esttmp{\th} + \inv{\einff{\esttmp{\th}}} \scoref{\vx; \esttmp{\th}}
$$

:::

::: notes
The expected information is sometimes simpler to compute
than the observed information.
:::
